items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: Well, I had an uncle who used to play guitar, Emil Gayno.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about, did anyone in your family play? Your father, mother, anyone play any music?

Well, I had an uncle who used to play guitar, Emil Gayno. He used to play with a band with slow drag in it, maybe 50 or 60 years ago. They had a small band, and I mean they played a lot of Creole songs. I remember slow drag telling me one of the main numbers they used to have was a number called, Macaque Manger Piment.
